tasks.completion_summary: Implemented MCP sampling/createMessage handler — SDK client registration, CLI --sampling-stub/--sampling-stub-file flags, TUI overlay screen with manual/canned/abort options, and full SDK round-trip integration tests.

Extended sampling support to CreateMessageWithTools (SDK v1.6.0): added WithToolsHandler interface, NewToolUseStubHandler with ParseToolUseSpec, --sampling-tool-use CLI flag, TUI tool-pick mode with cursor navigation, and end-to-end round-trip integration tests including tool_result follow-up.

Implemented MCP roots/list capability: new internal/mcp/roots package with ParseFlag (name=path) and LoadFile parsers, service-level SetInitialRoots/AddRoots/RemoveRoots/ListRoots wiring through SDK client.AddRoots/RemoveRoots, repeatable --root and --roots-file CLI flags, TUI roots-editor overlay accessible via 'R' from both connection and main screens with staging adapter for pre-connect edits, and end-to-end integration tests verifying roots/list visibility and roots/list_changed notification dispatch on the wire. Verified manually against @modelcontextprotocol/server-everything's get-roots-list tool.

Implemented client-side OAuth in new internal/mcp/oauth package: Handler dispatches to SDK's auth.AuthorizationCodeHandler (RFC 6749 §4.1 + RFC 7636 PKCE) or extauth.ClientCredentialsHandler (RFC 6749 §4.4) based on Config.Mode(); LocalServerFetcher binds an ephemeral loopback listener for the auth-code redirect with auto-discovery via PRM (RFC 9728) and ASM (RFC 8414); FileTokenCache persists tokens to platform-default cache dirs (XDG/Library/LOCALAPPDATA) with mode 0600 atomic writes; service.Connect plumbs OAuthHandler into StreamableClientTransport when ConnectionConfig.OAuth is set; new --oauth-client-id/--oauth-client-secret/--oauth-token-url/--oauth-scopes/--oauth-redirect-{host,port}/--oauth-dynamic-registration/--oauth-cache CLI flags shared by CLI and TUI launchers; TUI status indicator with color-coded state and 'A' Re-authenticate keybinding; mock OAuth server (handles /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server, /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource, /token, /authorize, /register) drives 23 tests covering client-credentials, auth-code+PKCE, DCR (RFC 7591), bad-secret rejection, OAuth error redirect, file cache round-trip/expiry/mode, scope dedup, and service wiring. OS keychain native bindings deferred to a follow-up per task size_note — file fallback fully covers the acceptance criterion.

Implemented Tier 2 capability inspector (SEP-2133 extensions): new internal/mcp/capabilities package with Snapshot type and FromInitializeResult/DeriveClientCapabilities pure functions; service.GetCapabilitiesSnapshot interface method capturing both server InitializeResult and derived client capabilities at connect time; new Capabilities tab (5th) in Ctrl+D debug overlay with snapshot-provider closure pattern, full server+client rendering including extensions/experimental maps, y/c-to-copy JSON action, and nil-safe wiring across main/tool/connection callers; new mcp-tui capabilities CLI subcommand emitting indented deterministic JSON (sorted keys at every level via map round-trip); 25 new tests covering rendering, JSON marshaling, deterministic ordering, omitempty for absent caps, nil-snapshot empty state, 5-tab navigation arithmetic, integration via real SDK Connect handshake, and CLI happy-path with stdout capture. Verified manually against @modelcontextprotocol/server-everything: emits valid JSON with 2025-11-25 protocol, all server caps + instructions, and clientCaps.roots.listChanged.

Implemented Tier 2 negotiated-protocol-version surfacing across TUI status bar, CLI debug output, and saved-connections persistence: new formatConnectedStatus helper renders 'Connected to <target> [MCP <version>]' from ms.mcpService.GetServerInfo().ProtocolVersion in handleConnectionSuccess (HTTP/SSE branch fixed to use URL instead of empty command); new printNegotiatedVersion in internal/cli/base.go fires '🔖 Negotiated MCP <version>' to stderr when --debug is set (registered the previously-unregistered --debug PersistentFlag in main.go that was being read but never declared); new ConnectionEntry.LastSeenVersion field with omitempty + new ConnectionsManager.UpdateLastUsedWithVersion method that preserves prior version on transient failure; SetConnectionSuccessHook on MainScreen lets the connection screen and auto-connect manager.go closure-wire UpdateLastUsedWithVersion to the negotiated version without coupling MainScreen to the models package; 14 new tests covering: ProtocolVersion extraction across 5 spec versions in capabilities, formatConnectedStatus for stdio/HTTP/no-version, hook firing + nil-safety in MainScreen.handleConnectionSuccess, UpdateLastUsedWithVersion happy-path + empty-version-preserves-prior + JSON round-trip + omitempty, printNegotiatedVersion with-debug/no-debug/no-version/nil-service. Verified manually against @modelcontextprotocol/server-everything: stderr now shows '🔖 Negotiated MCP 2025-11-25' under --debug.

Implemented Tier 2 notification stream pane: new internal/mcp/notifications package with thread-safe ring-buffer Stream (default cap 500), Type/Level constants, FromMethod method-name lookup, FromRequest+describeParams translator that reads typed SDK params for all 7 notification kinds (message, progress, resources/updated, tools|prompts|resources/list_changed, cancelled), Filter struct with HasTypes/AllowType/AllowLevel/Allow + FilterEntries pure function, and Entry.FormatLine/FormatJSON for unified TUI+CLI rendering; service.go captureNotificationsMiddleware uses client.AddReceivingMiddleware to capture all 7 types in one place — including notifications/cancelled which has no exposed SDK handler; Service interface gained NotificationStream() and AddNotificationObserver(); new tabNotifications (6th tab) in DebugScreen with tab-label count + ⏸ indicator, filter status line, digit-key (1-7) type toggles, 0=clear types, +/-=level threshold, Space/P=pause-resume, x=clear stream, c/y=copy JSON; closure-based notificationsProvider keeps DebugScreen decoupled from concrete service type; --watch-notifications CLI flag installs an observer that writes Entry.FormatLine to stderr per notification; 22 unit tests in notifications package (FromMethod table, AllTypes ordering, LevelRank fallback, Filter type/level branches, FilterEntries order preservation, ring buffer overflow + concurrent Append+Snapshot under -race, pause-drops-and-resume-no-backfill, FormatLine/FormatJSON), 9 translator tests (per-type describeParams + nil request + unknown method + truncate boundaries), 3 service round-trip tests against real in-memory SDK transport (capture all 7 types including cancelled via direct stream Append, observer fires for tools/list_changed, pause affects buffer), 8 TUI tests (no-provider hint, render entries, filter by type, filter by level, pause/resume, tab label count+pause indicator, clear stream), 2 CLI flag tests (off-by-default, observer registers when set). Verified manually against @modelcontextprotocol/server-everything: --watch-notifications captured 'tools/listChanged' and 'message [critical]  Critical-level message' to stderr.

Implemented Tier 2 tool annotations + destructive-confirm gate: new ToolAnnotations type and Title field on internal/mcp.Tool with DisplayName/IsDestructive/IsReadOnly/IsIdempotent/IsOpenWorld/BadgeString helpers (mcp-tui deliberately treats nil DestructiveHint as not-destructive so existing unannotated servers keep no-prompt behaviour); convertTool wires the SDK ToolAnnotations through, deep-copying *bool fields to avoid aliasing SDK memory; new internal/tui/screens/confirm.go ConfirmScreen overlay with Y/Enter to approve and N/Esc/q to cancel, emitting a typed ConfirmDecisionMsg + BackMsg via tea.Batch; manager.go forwards ConfirmDecisionMsg to the underlying screen even while overlay is mounted so the same batch closes the overlay and delivers the decision in one frame; ToolScreen.handleKeyMsg now opens the confirm overlay on Execute when IsDestructive(), tracks pendingConfirm + confirmBypassed flags so the second pass through executeTool runs the actual call; renderToolBadges (TUI) and renderCLIBadges (CLI) produce colored [D]/[R]/[I]/[O] badges (red/green/blue/gray) wired into TUI tool list, TUI tool detail, TUI execute screen, CLI tool list, and CLI describe; CLI tool call gained --no-confirm flag and confirmDestructiveCall(stdin, stderr, tool, skip) that prompts on TTY, refuses with a helpful error on non-TTY without --no-confirm, and short-circuits for non-destructive tools — the destructive lookup only does an extra ListTools roundtrip when --no-confirm is absent so scripted callers stay single-roundtrip; 22 new tests across mcp/annotations_test.go (DisplayName precedence, IsDestructive matrix incl. readOnly suppression, hint accessors, convert nil-passthrough + pointer-copy invariants, BadgeString table), screens/confirm_test.go (ConfirmScreen view+approve+reject+ignore-stray-keys, ToolScreen gates destructive on Execute, skips for readOnly, approves clears pendingConfirm + starts execution, denies cancels with status, ignores stale ToolName), and cli/tool_confirm_test.go (skip flag bypass, non-destructive no-op, non-TTY refuse with --no-confirm hint, readOnly suppresses gate, badge labels per hint type). All existing tests still pass.

Tier 2 outputSchema validation: new internal/mcp/outputvalidation package using google/jsonschema-go, plumbed through service.CallTool with per-tool schema cache, --strict-output CLI flag with stderr warning banner, and TUI yellow violation banner above result block.

Tier 2 resource templates + completion/complete: new internal/mcp/uritemplate package with IsTemplate/Variables/VariableAtCursor/Expand (RFC 6570 level-1 with operator/modifier handling), Service.ListResourceTemplates and Service.Complete with PromptRef/ResourceRef helpers and ContextArguments support, CLI `resource templates` and `resource complete <uri-template> <var>=<prefix>` subcommands plus matching `prompt complete <prompt-name> <var>=<prefix>`, new ResourceTemplateScreen TUI overlay with per-variable input fields, Tab-fires-completion, single-suggestion autofill, sibling-var ContextArguments, live preview of expanded URI, and refusal of incomplete expansion. Main screen loadResources() now also fetches resources/templates/list, buildResourceListItems renders a `── Templates ──` section header with templates as selectable rows that open the resolve overlay. 35 new tests: 23 in uritemplate (Variables/IsTemplate/VariableAtCursor/Expand tables), 5 service round-trips against in-memory SDK transport (ListResourceTemplates, Complete prompt arg with HasMore+Total, Complete resource template, Complete with ContextArguments, Complete input validation), 11 ResourceTemplateScreen+buildResourceListItems tests using a fakeCompletionService stub. Verified manually against @modelcontextprotocol/server-everything: prompt complete completable-prompt department= returns Engineering/Sales/Marketing/Support; resource templates lists demo://resource/dynamic/text/{resourceId} and demo://resource/dynamic/blob/{resourceId}.

Tier 3 isError:true classification: distinguished v1.5.0 input-validation tool-result errors from JSON-RPC protocol errors across TUI and CLI. CLI: new --strict-errors flag mirroring --strict-output pattern, isError notice routed to stderr (not stdout) so jq-piping scripts keep working, new reportToolError(isError, strict) helper for testable exit-code policy. TUI: red/white-text banner above result block on IsError=true distinct from yellow outputSchema banner and from JSON-RPC ts.LastError() footer surface; status bar now reads 'Tool reported an error (isError:true)' instead of misleading 'executed successfully' when IsError=true. Service: TestService_CallTool_IsErrorVsJSONRPCError integration test against in-memory SDK transport with a strict-schema tool proves bad input returns CallToolResult{IsError:true} on the wire (not a JSON-RPC error); companion TestService_CallTool_IsError_NotFoundIsJSONRPC confirms the OPPOSITE direction (unknown tool = JSON-RPC error path) so both classifications are guarded. 11 new tests across cli/tool_iserror_test.go (4: strict happy/sad path, flag registration), screens/tool_iserror_test.go (4: banner shown/hidden, status message, distinguishable-from-outputSchema), mcp/service_iserror_test.go (3: bad input → isError, happy path, unknown tool → JSON-RPC). All existing tests still pass; -race clean on new tests; gofmt/vet clean for all 5 modified files.

Tier 3 SEP-2243 MCP-Method/MCP-Name advisory headers: new internal/mcp/transports/method_headers.go with methodHeadersRoundTripper that parses the JSON-RPC body, sets MCP-Method to the method name and MCP-Name to params.name (tools/call, prompts/get, resources/{subscribe,unsubscribe}, completion/complete) or params.uri (resources/read), preserving the body for retries via GetBody+ContentLength. SetRequestHeaderObserver lets the mcp package register a hook so the injected headers reach the Ctrl+D HTTP debug tab even though our HTTP/SSE clients use a custom transport that the global debugRoundTripper does not wrap. New GetHTTPClientForTransportWithMethodHeaders wraps the existing client transport only when the flag is set, leaving default behavior intact. ConnectionConfig.MCPMethodHeaders + TransportConfig.MCPMethodHeaders + config_adapter pass-through; factory.go uses the new helper for SSE/HTTP/streamable-HTTP. New --mcp-method-headers persistent flag in main.go honored by both CLI parseConnectionConfig and the TUI launcher. http_debug.go: new RequestHeaders field on HTTPErrorInfo, captured in debugRoundTripper, surfaced in FormatHTTPError above the request body; init() registers the observer to populate lastHTTPError on every JSON-RPC request when the flag is enabled. 10 new tests in transports/method_headers_test.go covering tools/call sets both, prompts/get sets name, resources/read uses URI, list methods set method only, initialize sets method only, non-JSON GET passes through untouched, body forwarded intact to inner transport, observer fires with correct values, GetHTTPClientForTransport injects headers when flag on, omits when off (verified against real httptest.Server). All existing tests pass; go vet clean; binary --help shows the new flag.

Tier 3 header forwarding visualization: new internal/mcp/header_display.go with RedactHeaders pure function (Authorization, Cookie, Set-Cookie redacted as [REDACTED] by default; case-insensitive matching; defensive copy so re-rendering doesn't lose values), ParseShowHeadersCSV (trim+dedupe), and atomic.Value-backed SetShowHeaderOverrides/GetShowHeaderOverrides register read by the debug HTTP tab and CLI formatter. New internal/mcp/transports/static_headers.go with newStaticHeadersRoundTripper (additive merge — never stomps existing protocol headers like Content-Type), ParseHeaderFlag (splits on first '=' so base64 tokens with trailing '=' survive), ParseHeaderFlags (last-write-wins on duplicate keys). New internal/mcp/transports/response_observer.go with SetResponseObserver/getResponseObserver atomic register and responseObserverRoundTripper that fires the hook on every round-trip including failures. method_headers.go: new GetHTTPClientForTransportFull layers SEP-2243 method headers (outermost), static --header values, and response observer (innermost) so each layer sees the merged outbound request. http_debug.go init() now registers BOTH a request observer (preserves iter 13 SEP-2243 capture) AND a response observer (captureRoundTrip populates lastHTTPError with full request+response headers per round-trip, not just on errors/SSE/debugMode like the old debugRoundTripper). FormatHTTPErrorWithOverrides applies redaction + sorted output for stable diffs; FormatHTTPError unchanged for backwards compat. New --header KEY=VALUE persistent flag (StringArray, repeatable) and --show-headers comma-separated flag in main.go, mirrored into ConnectionConfig.Headers + global show-overrides register from both CLI base.go (parseConnectionConfig) and TUI launcher in main.go. Tests: 6 RedactHeaders cases (defaults, case-insensitive, override, empty, no-mutate), 5 ParseShowHeadersCSV cases, 2 FormatHTTPError redaction cases, captureRoundTrip end-to-end populating canonical Mcp-Method/Mcp-Name keys, 3 staticHeadersRoundTripper merge cases, 6 ParseHeaderFlag/ParseHeaderFlags cases, 3 full-pipeline tests (forwards static + SEP-2243 to wire without conflict, observer sees method headers post-injection, observer fires on round-trip error). Verified --header BAD_NO_EQUALS rejection at CLI parse time. All existing tests pass; go vet clean; binary --help shows --header, --show-headers, and --mcp-method-headers.
